examples.reading: このほんはよみやすい。
examples.gloss: This book is easy to read.

examples.japanese: このペンは書きやすいです。
examples.reading: このペンはかきやすいです。
examples.gloss: This pen is easy to write with.

usage: Easy to do. It describes how easy the thing is to handle, not what the person does.
It also means 'tends to': 怒りやすい (quick to anger), 風邪をひきやすい (catches colds easily).

compare.difference: The opposite. 難しい just says something is hard. ～にくい says it is hard to do.

compare.label: 簡単な
compare.difference: 簡単な describes the task as simple. やすい describes how easily you can use or handle the thing.
